title: A running number in both files is never a label-join key (dclab-core 0.110.1)
request: Step 5, part 2 of the 100-students plan: measure the label-join key's rule on planted traps; a student only where the rule errs, a product fix where a whisper protects nobody.
spec: dclab_core.analyse.label_join: the candidates a label file may join on; studio/labels.py review chooses the one finding most label rows.
plan: Plant traps: a shared row number, an entity key, missing labelled cases, ids written as zero-padded text.
Measure the rule's pick against the true key.
Fix in dclab_core, coordinated with the other session's versions.

decisions.decision: Refuse a column that is a running number in BOTH files, not in either one.
decisions.why: An order id may itself run 1 to n in the table (the reason the name-only check existed); a real key in a label file is a subset of the table's, never the run 1 to k again.

decisions.decision: A patch version, 0.110.1, after the other session's 0.110.0.
decisions.why: Two sessions bump dclab_core: the version follows whatever HEAD holds, and they were told before.

decisions.decision: Zero-padded text ids against integers left as they are.
decisions.why: The person sees that no key was found; '007' and '7' can be different codes, so stripping zeros could join the wrong rows.

change: dclab_core/analyse.py (_running, _key_candidates), dclab_core/__init__.py, pyproject.toml, CHANGELOG.md (0.110.1), docs/DATA_CATALOG.md and data_catalog.json (the version), tests/test_core_label_join_running.py.

findings.defect: A running number won the join and marked the table's first rows as the cases.
findings.scenario: A label file of 60 cases, a tenth of them missing from this export, both files with a column 'line' numbering their rows: the rule joined on 'line' in 10 of 10 tables.
findings.cause: Only a saved pandas index was refused, by its name ('Unnamed: 0', 'index', 'row_id'); 'line', 'S.No' or 'ردیف' found every label row while the true key found nine in ten.
findings.fix: _key_candidates refuses a column that is a running number of its own file in both files.

findings.defect: Ids written as zero-padded text in the label file find no key.
findings.scenario: order_id 100023 in the table, '00100023' in the labels: no key in 10 of 10.
findings.fix: Left: the person is told no key was found; stripping zeros could join codes that differ.
findings.test: the planted traps, kept in the session

measurements.name: planted label files
measurements.gate: affected tests only (the owner's daytime rule)
measurements.result: the right key on clean files, a shared row number, an entity key and missing cases in 10 of 10 each (missing cases 0 of 10 before); zero-padded text ids still find none

outcome: A label file can no longer mark a table's first rows as its cases through a running number under any name.
lessons: A rule that refuses by name only misses the same thing under another name; refuse by what the values are, and ask both files.
risks: A label file that is exactly the first k orders of a table numbered 1 to n would be refused on that column: very unlikely, and the person can still name the key.
